about: Byte budgets for the production client build, enforced by scripts/check-page-budgets.mjs (make budget, and the production image job in CI). Text is measured gzipped at level 9, images as they are. Each budget sits at most 10% above what the build measures, rounded up: ceil(measured * 1.10). A budget above that fails the check, which prints the number to set, so a pull request that makes a page smaller lowers its budget in the same pull request. The rule dates from 2026-09-28, when every budget it flagged was lowered to its number. An entry under floors may sit at its floor instead, for a file so small that 10% of it is a few bytes. home-initial counts the route chunks the home page head preloads since 2026-09-28. To raise one deliberately, change it here in the pull request that needs it and say why in that pull request. The lighthouse:<route> entries are the bytes a route transfers in the Lighthouse job, the median of 5 runs, checked by tools/lighthouse/gate.mjs under the same 10% rule. They are set 5% above the measurement, since response headers make a network count move by a few bytes between runs.
